items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: So in June of 52 was the first graduating class of Joseph S. Clark. Mm-hmm. You were there? I was in it and I was in the band.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Okay. It was a, it was down on the main street. It was an old bell school. Mm-hmm. And that was our first school and they moved to Barracks in Robes, Durban in 1950. About 1950 they moved there. So in June of 52 was the first graduating class of Joseph S. Clark. Mm-hmm. You were there? I was in it and I was in the band. In the band we had 65 people.
Well, name, actually the name of all 65. Who?
